d: Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping come together in Shenzhen, China, for a historic trilateral meeting on the sidelines of the 2026 APEC Summit. The leaders discuss nuclear weapons, the New START treaty, the wars in Iran and Ukraine, and tensions over Taiwan. But beyond the discussions, Xi Jinping's warm reception of Trump and the contrasting moments with Putin draw attention to the summit's diplomatic dynamics. What did the meeting achieve, and what message did Beijing send to Washington and Moscow? Watch the key moments and geopolitical implications of this unprecedented…
